answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Each submission hangs on the gale of a task receipt, and the delta is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, voided if the audit panel is not diverse. Reaching the kernel of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
